battleCards.name: Genestealer Hybrids
battleCards.effect_1: Requires: Gaunt / Devourer.
battleCards.effect_2: Force enemy to lose 1 [G], 1 [S], or 1 [M], whichever he has most of. If tied, you choose. Then gain 1 [G], 1 [S], or 1 [M], whichever your enemy lost.

battleCards.name: Hive Tyrant
battleCards.effect_1: Play 1 combat card from your hand. Do not resolve its abilities, but gain its combat icons during this combat. Requires: Warrior / Hive Ship.
battleCards.effect_2: Either rally 1 of your units. Spend 1 [M] to gain either 1 [G] or 1 [S].

battleCards.name: Hormagaunt Brood
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 1 (s). Requires: Gaunt / Devourer.
battleCards.effect_2: Destroy 1 unrouted Gaunt or Devourer to gain 3 (g).

battleCards.name: Rain of Spores
battleCards.effect_1: Destroy 1 unrouted Devourer in this system to place 1 free Warrior on this world.

battleCards.name: Ripper Swarms
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 2 (g). Requires: Gaunt / Devourer.
battleCards.effect_2: At the end of this execution round, gain 1 materiel for each unit destroyed during this execution round, to a maximum of 2.

battleCards.name: Termagaunt Brood
battleCards.effect_1: Either gain 1 (g) for each unrouted Gaunt or Devourer or place 1 free reinforcement token in this area. For each Gaunt or Devourer destroyed or routed this execution round, reduce damage you suffer in the next execution round by 1.

battleCards.name: Warrior Brood
battleCards.effect_1: Destroy 1 of your unrouted units to gain 2 (s) and reduce the damage you suffer in the next execution round by 2. Requires: Warrior / Hive Ship.
battleCards.effect_2: Reroll all of your [G], [S], or [M].

battleCards.name: Winged Horror
battleCards.effect_1: Destroy 1 of your unrouted units to gain 3 (g). Requires: Warrior / Devourer.
battleCards.effect_2: Your enemy may allow you to gain 2 (s). If he does not, add 2 to your offence value in the next execution round.

battleCards.name: Crushing Claws
battleCards.effect_1: Destroy 1 of your unrouted units to gain 3 (g). Requires: Carnifex / Hive Ship.
battleCards.effect_2: Spend either 1 [G] or 1 [M] to force your enemy to lose 2 [S].

battleCards.name: Scything Talons
battleCards.effect_1: During this execution round, if enemy has to assign any damage, he assigns 3 additional damage. Requires: Carnifex / Hive Ship.
battleCards.effect_2: Destroy 1 unrouted Carnifex or Hive Ship to gain 3 (g) and 2 (s).

battleCards.name: Synaptic Control
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 1 [?]. Place 1 free (R) in this area. Requires: Warrior / Hive Ship.
battleCards.effect_2: Rally 1 of your units. Gain either 1 (g) or 1 (s) for each of your unrouted units in excess of the number of your enemy's unrouted units.

battleCards.name: Glory of the Swarm
battleCards.effect_1: Spend any number of [M]. For each [M] you spend, gain either 1 [G] or 1 [S]. Requires: Bio-Titan / Hive Ship.
battleCards.effect_2: Rally all of your units. During this execution round, you assign damage to your enemy's units and bastions.

battleCards.name: Overwhelming Presence
battleCards.effect_1: Destroy 1 of your unrouted units to gain either 3 (g) or 3 (s). Requires: Bio-Titan / Hive Ship.
battleCards.effect_2: Force your enemy to choose 3 times to either choose and rout 1 of his units or lose 1 die of his choice.

orderUpgrades.name: Genestealer Infiltration
orderUpgrades.effect_1: Orbital Strike, once per round. Gain 1 [?].
orderUpgrades.effect_2: May spend up to 2 [G] to gain 1 (R) for each [G] you spend.

orderUpgrades.name: Breeding Chambers
orderUpgrades.effect_1: After you resolve this order, may purchase up to 2 units for each unrouted Hive Ship in the active system and place them on any friendly or unfriendly worlds in the active system. Once per round.

orderUpgrades.name: Capillary Towers
orderUpgrades.effect_1: After you resolve this order, may destroy any of your units or structures on a world in the active system to temporarily gain materiel equal to their materiel cost. Use this materiel only to purchase ships in the active system. Once per round.

orderUpgrades.name: Without Number
orderUpgrades.effect_1: While resolving this order in a system in which you have an unrouted ship, you may place 1 free (R) in the contested area at the start of a reinforce step of combat. Once per round.

orderUpgrades.name: Mycetic Spores
orderUpgrades.effect_1: Orbital Strike, once per round. Requires Breeding Chambers. Bastions do not prevent orbital strike.
orderUpgrades.effect_2: Spend up to 2 [G] for each participating Hive Ship. For each [G] you spend, purchase 1 unit Tier 2 or less and place it on the world. Command Level 2.

eventCards.name: Brood Nests
eventCards.effect: Before revealing an order during the Operations Phase, may discard to place 1 free Gaunt on each of 2 different friendly worlds.

eventCards.name: Devourer of Worlds
eventCards.effect: Choose a system. Gain materiel equal to the materiel value of friendly worlds in that system.

eventCards.name: Hive Mind
eventCards.effect: While resolving an order, may discard this card to increase your Tier by 1 for each of your Hive Ships.

eventCards.name: Infiltration Organisms
eventCards.effect: Purchase 1 combat upgrade, reducing its materiel cost by 1 for each of your Hive Ships.

eventCards.name: Rapid Mutation
eventCards.effect: Gain 2 (F).

eventCards.name: Rise of the Faithful
eventCards.effect: Instead of revealing an order during the Operations Phase, may discard this card to place 1 free bastion on a friendly world not containing a structure.

eventCards.name: Shadow in the Warp
eventCards.effect: May discard this card when you start a combat. If you do, your enemy cannot use reinforcement tokens during the combat.

eventCards.name: Splinter Fleet
eventCards.effect: Place 1 free Devourer on any friendly void.

tau.name: Tau
tau.flavor: Dominate: When you resolve a dominate order in a system containing at least 1 of your units or structures, you may draw 4 cards from the top of your event deck. Resolve the ability of 1 of those cards and discard the others.

battleCards.name: Crossfire
battleCards.effect_1: At the start of the assess damage step of this execution round, your enemy loses 3 (g). Requires: Fire Warrior / Battlesuit / Protector.
battleCards.effect_2: Gain 2 (g).

battleCards.name: Kroot Hunting Packs
battleCards.effect_1: If you have fewer units than your enemy, gain 1 (s) and your enemy loses 1 [G]. Otherwise, gain 1 (g). Requires: Fire Warrior / Protector.
battleCards.effect_2: Gain 1 [?].

battleCards.name: Pathfinder Teams
battleCards.effect_1: Requires: Fire Warrior / Protector.
battleCards.effect_2: If you are attacking, look at your enemy's facedown combat card. Play 1 combat card from your hand. Then discard this card.

battleCards.name: Stealth Teams
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 1 (s). Requires: Fire Warrior / Protector.
battleCards.effect_2: Your enemy may choose and rout 1 of his units. If he does not, force your enemy to lose 1 [G], 1 [S], or 1 [M].

battleCards.name: Tactical Retreat
battleCards.effect_1: Retreat 1 of your units. If you do, you may spend 1 [M] to rally that unit. Requires: Fire Warrior / Protector.
battleCards.effect_2: Gain 2 (s).

battleCards.name: Evasion
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 1 [?]. Requires: Fire Warrior / Protector.
battleCards.effect_2: During this execution round, if any of your unrouted Tier 0 units become routed or are destroyed, you may take them and place them back in this area at the end of the assess damage step.

battleCards.name: Feigned Retreat
battleCards.effect_1: Your enemy must reroll all [S]. You must reroll either 2 [S] or retreat 1 of your units. Requires: Fire Warrior / Battlesuit / Protector.
battleCards.effect_2: If none of your units retreated during this execution round, gain 2 (g).

battleCards.name: Kauyon
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 1 (s). At the end of this execution round, if you are defending, you may move 1 of your units from an adjacent area to this area. Gain [?] equal to that unit's combat value.

battleCards.name: Mont'ka
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 2 (g). Choose 1 of your enemy's units or bastions. That unit or bastion suffers damage first during this execution round. Requires: Battlesuit / Protector.
battleCards.effect_2: Spend up to 2 dice. For each dice you spend, gain 2 (g).

battleCards.name: Fire and Movement
battleCards.effect_1: Reroll all of your [G], [S], or [M]. Requires: Hammerhead / Custodian.
battleCards.effect_2: During this execution round, when 1 of your units is destroyed during the assess damage step, you may retreat that unit instead.

battleCards.name: Firefight
battleCards.effect_1: At the start of the assess damage step of this execution round, enemy loses 3 (g). Requires: Battlesuit / Hammerhead / Custodian.
battleCards.effect_2: Gain 1 (s). Force your enemy to lose either 1 [G] or 1 [M].

battleCards.name: Regroup
battleCards.effect_1: Spend any number of dice. For every 2 dice you spend, rally 1 of your units. Requires: Hammerhead / Custodian.
battleCards.effect_2: Gain 2 [?].

battleCards.name: For the Greater Good
battleCards.effect_1: Your enemy must reroll all [G]. Requires: Supremacy / Custodian.
battleCards.effect_2: Force your enemy to lose 3 [M]. For each [M] your enemy cannot lose, gain 2 (g).

battleCards.name: Supremacy
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 2 (g). Spend up to 2 [M]. For each [M], gain either 1 [G] or 1 [S]. Requires: Supremacy / Custodian.
battleCards.effect_2: During this execution round, the health value of your enemy's units is reduced to 3.

orderUpgrades.name: Precision Strikes
orderUpgrades.effect_1: Orbital Strike, once per round. Gain 1 [?].
orderUpgrades.effect_2: May spend 1 die of your choice to choose 1 enemy unit on the world. That unit must suffer damage first during this orbital strike.

orderUpgrades.name: Gue'vesa Allies
orderUpgrades.effect_1: When you reveal this order in a system containing 1 of your units or structures and a friendly or uncontrolled world, you may spend 1 materiel to place 1 free Tier 0 unit on a friendly or uncontrolled area in the active system. Once per round.

orderUpgrades.name: Mobilised Hunter Cadres
orderUpgrades.effect_1: Before you resolve this order, you may resolve an additional Advance Order using only 1 of your Tier 0 or Tier 1 units already in the active system. If combat occurs, resolve 1 execution round only. Once per round.

orderUpgrades.name: Teachings of Tau'va
orderUpgrades.effect_1: When you reveal this order token, you may place 3 of your order tokens from your play area onto the top of your event deck. Once per round.

orderUpgrades.name: Targeting Array
orderUpgrades.effect_1: Orbital Strike, once per round. Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. Gain 1 [?].

eventCards.name: Autonomous Drones
eventCards.effect: Rout 1 enemy unit of Tier 2 or less that is in a system containing at least 1 of your units.

eventCards.name: Critical Strike
eventCards.effect: When an enemy unit suffers damage during combat, you may discard this card to destroy that unit.

eventCards.name: Denial of Supplies
eventCards.effect: You may discard this card at the start of combat. If you do, your enemy cannot place (R) from his play area into the contested area during the reinforce step of combat.

eventCards.name: Evacuation
eventCards.effect: Destroy 1 of your structures in any system to place 1 free structure on a different friendly world not containing a structure in the same or adjacent system.

eventCards.name: Philosophy of War
eventCards.effect: You may discard this card at the start of combat. If you do, replace any number of pairs of combat cards from your combat deck with pairs of combat cards of the same or lower Tier from your upgrade deck.

eventCards.name: Rapid Response
eventCards.effect: Choose a system. Move any of your units between friendly or uncontrolled areas in the chosen system.

eventCards.name: Sabotage
eventCards.effect: Destroy 1 of your unrouted units in any system to destroy 1 enemy structure in that system.

eventCards.name: War Council
eventCards.effect: Before revealing an order during the Operations Phase, you may discard this card to rally all of your units in any 1 system.

imperial_guard.name: Imperial Guard
imperial_guard.flavor: Dominate: When you resolve a dominate order, you may resolve a deploy order, only to purchase 2 or more identical units and placing them on either 1 friendly world containing a structure or 1 friendly or uncontrolled void. Reduce the materiel cost of each unit by 1.

battleCards.name: Fire Support
battleCards.effect_1: If you are defending, gain 2 (s). Otherwise, opponent loses 2 (s). Requires: Guardsman / Cruiser.
battleCards.effect_2: Reroll 1 [S].

battleCards.name: For the Emperor!
battleCards.effect_1: Reroll 1 of your dice. Requires: Guardsman / Cruiser.
battleCards.effect_2: Gain 1 (g) for each unrouted Guardsman or Cruiser, to a maximum of 3.

battleCards.name: Incoming!
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 1 [?]. Requires: Guardsman / Cruiser.
battleCards.effect_2: Gain 1 (s) for each unrouted Guardsman or Cruiser, to a maximum of 3.

battleCards.name: Iron Discipline
battleCards.effect_1: Gain 1 [?] for each of your unrouted units of a different Tier. Requires: Guardsman / Cruiser.
battleCards.effect_2: Rally 1 of your units.

battleCards.name: Ratling Marksmen
battleCards.effect_1: At the start of the assess damage step of this execution round, your enemy loses 2 (g). Requires: Guardsman / Cruiser.
battleCards.effect_2: Your enemy chooses and routs 1 of his units unless he spends 1 die of his choice.

battleCards.name: Bullgryn Bulwark
battleCards.effect_1: You must reroll 2 [G] or [M]. Requires: Ogryn / Cruiser.
battleCards.effect_2: Gain 1 (g) for each unrouted Guardsman or Cruiser, to a maximum of 3.

battleCards.name: Mechanised Combat Group
battleCards.effect_1: At the start of the assess damage step of this execution round, your enemy loses either 3 (g) or 3 (s) for each pairing of unrouted Guardsmen with Ogryns or Cruisers with Battleships.

battleCards.name: Ogryn Shock Troops
battleCards.effect_1: You must reroll 2 [S] or [M]. Requires: Ogryn / Cruiser.
battleCards.effect_2: Gain 1 (s) for each unrouted Guardsman or Cruiser, to a maximum of 3.

battleCards.name: Sentinel Reconnaissance
battleCards.effect_1: If you have more unrouted units than your enemy, your enemy chooses and routs 1 of his units unless he spends 1 [M]. Requires: Ogryn / Cruiser.
battleCards.effect_2: If you are attacking, look at your enemy's facedown combat card. Gain either 2 [G] or 2 [S].

battleCards.name: Armoured Spearhead
battleCards.effect_1: Either destroy up to 2 unrouted Guardsmen to force your enemy to lose 2 dice of his choice for each destroyed Guardsman, or destroy 1 unrouted Cruiser to force your enemy to lose 3 dice of his choice. Requires: Leman Russ / Battleship.
battleCards.effect_2: Choose 1 of your enemy's Tier 2 or Tier 3 units or bastions. That unit or bastion suffers damage first during this execution round.

battleCards.name: Combined Arms
battleCards.effect_1: For each of your unrouted ground units of a different Tier, gain either 1 (g) or 1 (s). For each of your unrouted ships of a different Tier, gain either 2 (g) or 2 (s). Gain 1 [?]. Rally 1 of your units.

battleCards.name: Wyvern Suppression Fire
battleCards.effect_1: If you have more unrouted Tier 0 units than your enemy, your enemy chooses and routs 1 of his units. Requires: Leman Russ / Battleship.
battleCards.effect_2: Your enemy chooses and destroys 1 of his routed Tier 0 or Tier 1 units.

battleCards.name: Hammer of the Emperor
battleCards.effect_1: Force your enemy to lose 1 [S]. Requires: Warhound Titan / Battleship.
battleCards.effect_2: Warhound Titan: Gain 2 (g) for each of your unrouted units of a different Tier, to a maximum of 6. Battleship: Gain 3 (g) for each of your unrouted units of a different Tier.

battleCards.name: Titan Support
battleCards.effect_1: Your enemy must reroll 1 [G] for each of your unrouted units of a different Tier. Requires: Warhound Titan / Battleship.
battleCards.effect_2: During this execution round, your units of Tier 2 or less cannot become routed.

orderUpgrades.name: Saturation Bombing
orderUpgrades.effect_1: Orbital Strike, once per round. Gain 1 [?].
orderUpgrades.effect_2: You may convert 1 of your [M] into 1 [G].

orderUpgrades.name: Adeptus Astronomica
orderUpgrades.effect_1: While resolving this order, you may move up to 6 units to a world, if at least 1 of those units is a Guardsman. Once per round.
orderUpgrades.effect_2: After you resolve this order, you may retreat any Guardsmen in excess of that world's unit capacity. Command Level 1.

orderUpgrades.name: Departmento Munitorum
orderUpgrades.effect_1: While resolving this order, you may purchase 1 upgrade only. Then resolve a limited Deploy, Advance, or Dominate order in the active system. Once per round.

orderUpgrades.name: Forced Recruitment
orderUpgrades.effect_1: While resolving this order, you may treat all your cities in the active system as factories capable of deploying Guardsmen only. The unit capacity of friendly worlds containing a city is increased by 2, to a maximum of 4 (Guardsmen only). Once per round.

orderUpgrades.name: Virus Bombs
orderUpgrades.effect_1: Orbital Strike, once per round. Enemy bastions do not prevent orbital strike.
orderUpgrades.effect_2: During this orbital strike, the health value of your enemy's units is reduced to 3. Command Level 2.

eventCards.name: Call of the Astropaths
eventCards.effect: At the end of a reinforce step of combat, if you are defending, you may discard this card to place 2 free (R) in the contested area.

eventCards.name: Deathstrike Missile
eventCards.effect: You may discard this card at the start of combat on any world. If you do, either destroy 1 Tier 0 or 1 Tier 1 unit on that world or rout 1 Tier 2 unit on that world at the end of the first assess damage step.

eventCards.name: Order of the High Command
eventCards.effect: Purchase 1 combat upgrade, reducing its materiel cost by 1 for each friendly world containing a factory.

eventCards.name: Imperial Tithe
eventCards.effect: Either place 2 free Guardsmen on 1 friendly world in a system containing at least 1 of your factories or place 1 free Guardsman on any friendly world.

eventCards.name: Military Production Shift
eventCards.effect: Choose a friendly world. Gain assets from this world and gain materiel equal to its materiel value.

eventCards.name: Lance Strike
eventCards.effect: Before you perform an orbital strike, you may discard this card to add 2 to the total amount of damage suffered by your enemy's units.

eventCards.name: Tactical Genius
eventCards.effect: Instead of playing a combat card from your hand, you may discard this card to play any card from either your combat deck or your upgrade deck, other than a card that has already been played.

eventCards.name: Tempestus Scions
eventCards.effect: Rout 1 enemy Tier 0 or Tier 1 unit that is either in a system containing at least 1 of your units or in an adjacent system.
